brief: A macOS app that turns simple parts into clean, animated isometric blueprints: exploded views, section cuts and labelled diagrams. For designers, technical illustrators and makers. The mark should feel precise and crafted, read at 16 px, and avoid the generic cube-and-grid look of the category.
criteria: Success: says 'exploded view' at a glance, distinct from plain isometric cubes, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Lift
concepts.idea: The top of the block lifts off: an exploded view in its simplest form.
rationale: Shows the app's signature move, exploding a part, in three flat shapes
The moving part is marked in Redline, the body in Blueprint blue: both palettes ship in the app
Built on the same 30° isometric grid the app draws on, so it sits naturally on the canvas
A small-size cut opens the gaps so the lift still reads at 16 px

recommendation: Lift: one clear idea, ownable through the gap, and strong from the 16 px favicon to the App Store tile.
next_steps: Run a trademark search before public launch
Use the reversed files on dark and blue backgrounds
Keep build_kit.py and make-icon.swift in sync if the geometry changes
